description: Shared admission vectors for pipeline-node-settings-v1.json. Every layer (Worker compiler node_settings_tests.rs, Main pipelinelimits node_settings_test.go, Web runtimeContract.nodeSettings.test.ts) runs each document and must admit it (refusal null) or refuse it with the named refusal key, naming the node (null for a document-level refusal). Every document is otherwise valid for the Worker compiler.

cases.name: state modifier continues
cases.yaml:
state:
  out: str
  total: {type: int, value: 0, reducer: sum_int}
entry_point: a
nodes:
  - id: a
    type: state_modifier
    template: x
    output: [out]
    settings: {on_error: continue, always_output_data: true}
    transition: b
  - id: b
    type: state_modifier
    template: '1'
    output: [total]
    transition: END
